jedis.signature: String himportSet(String key, HashImport fieldset, String... values)

params.name: key
params.description: the key of the hash to create; any existing hash at this key is replaced

params.name: fieldset

params.name: values

lettuce_sync.signature: String himportSet(K key, HashImport<K> fieldset, V... values)

params.name: key
params.description: the key of the hash to create, must not be null.

params.name: fieldset
params.description: the field names to import into, must not be null and must not be closed.

params.name: values
params.description: the values in fieldset order, must not be null and must contain exactly HashImport#size() elements.
